abilities.name: Spectrum Beam
abilities.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to 1% of Asta's ATK to a single enemy.

abilities.name: Meteor Storm
abilities.text: Deals Fire DMG equal to 0.5% of Asta's ATK to a single enemy and further deals DMG for 4 extra times, with each time dealing Fire DMG equal to 0.5% of Asta's ATK to a random enemy.

abilities.name: Astral Blessing
abilities.text: Increases SPD of all allies by 50 for 2 turn(s).

abilities.name: Astrometry
abilities.text:
Gains 1 stack of Charging for every different enemy hit by Asta plus an extra stack if the enemy hit has Fire Weakness.
For every stack of Charging Asta has, all allies' ATK increases by 0.14%, up to 5 time(s).
Starting from her second turn, Asta's Charging stack count is reduced by 3 at the beginning of every turn.

abilities.name: Miracle Flash
abilities.text: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Fire DMG equal to 0.5% of Asta's ATK to all enemies.

abilities.name: Sparks
abilities.desc: Asta's Basic ATK has a 80% base chance to Burn enemies for 3 turn(s), making the enemy take Fire DoT equal to 50% of Asta's Basic ATK DMG at the start of each turn.

abilities.name: Ignite
abilities.desc: When Asta is on the field, all allies' Fire DMG increases by 18%.

abilities.name: Constellation
abilities.desc: Asta's DEF increases by 6% for every current Charging stack she possesses.

abilities.name: Star Sings Sans Verses or Vocals
abilities.desc: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to a random enemy.

abilities.name: Moon Speaks in Wax and Wane
abilities.desc: After using her Ultimate, Asta's Charging stacks will not be reduced in the next turn.

abilities.name: Meteor Showers for Wish and Want
abilities.desc: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

abilities.name: Aurora Basks in Beauty and Bliss
abilities.desc: Asta's Energy Regeneration Rate increases by 15% when she has 2 or more Charging stacks.

abilities.name: Nebula Secludes in Cold Cosmos
abilities.desc: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

abilities.name: Galaxy Dreams in Calm and Comfort
abilities.desc: Charging stack(s) lost in each turn is reduced by 1.
